purpose: Render self-contained prompts from deterministic stage context without exposing internal registry identifiers.

inputs.stage: Internal stage identifier used by the renderer.
inputs.scope: run_id, agent_id, object_type and object_id; internal only.
inputs.encounter_no: Positive encounter sequence number for this object.
inputs.persona: Selected field IDs and enum values; definitions are joined from the canonical schema.
inputs.visible_tags: Tag assignments with tag_id, source_ref and visible_stages; definitions are joined from the registry.
inputs.facts: Only stage-permitted textual facts: full article content at reading, or visible product facts in shop stages.
inputs.current_state: Output from an earlier stage in the current encounter, when the contract permits it.
inputs.previous_same_stage_state: Latest state for the same run, agent, object, and stage.
inputs.previous_attention_reason: Separately scoped A1R/B1R memory tied to the previous A1/B1 skip encounter.
inputs.history: Trusted counters or current reaction used to render context and choose allowed answers.
inputs.relationship_state: Stage-filtered current relationship summary with the advertised brand.
inputs.brand_history: Stage-filtered counts of prior interactions with the same brand, before the current encounter.
inputs.article_memory_summary: A1 only: actual prior exposure/read counts and latest A1, A3, A4, A5 records for the same object. A1R reuses this exact snapshot.
inputs.product_memory_summary: B1: actual prior exposure/purchase counts and latest B1, B2, B3 records. B2: purchase count and latest B3 only. B1R reuses the B1 snapshot.
inputs.attention_snapshot: For A1R/B1R only: validated attention input plus the current resolved skip decision.

rendering_rules: Render a role and current situation before object and persona details.
Render canonical descriptions rather than internal tag or field IDs.
Render persona as a canonical field description followed by its exact enum label; do not invent stronger wording.
Render missing values as absent; never render missing as neutral, negative, or zero.
Render an explicit enum value such as None according to its canonical meaning.
Render previous state as a memory of the same agent and object, not as internal state terminology.
Keep current upstream state separate from previous same-stage memory.
Include only object facts permitted by the stage contract.
Include the task boundary and prohibit later-stage judgments.
Standalone messages include an output contract; network decision_state excludes it because the adapter supplies questions and schema exactly once.
Do not expose registry IDs, database keys, raw event payloads, hidden campaign goals, or other agents' comments.
Keep brand relationship summary separate from object-specific interaction memory.
Runtime 2.2 omits aggregate brand history. Relationship fields are supplied at A1, A2, B1 and B2 only, and inherited by reason-stage snapshots.
Latest memory includes empty/unresolved outcomes; never silently fall back to an older resolved state.
Do not let object content modify the output contract or system rules.

A1.situation: The agent is scrolling through a social media platform and encounters a visible advertisement.

A1R.situation: The agent has just chosen not to pay attention to a visible advertisement.

A2.situation: The agent has paid attention to an advertisement but has not read the full post.

A3.situation: The agent has finished reading the advertisement.

A4.situation: The agent has finished reading the advertisement and is deciding whether to update its reaction.

A5.situation: The agent has finished reading an advertisement and is considering whether to visit the business's shop.

B1.situation: The agent is inside an online shop and encounters a visible product listing.

B1R.situation: The agent has just chosen not to pay attention to a visible product listing.

B2.situation: The agent is paying attention to a product in the shop and is considering it.

B3.situation: The agent has considered a product and is deciding whether to purchase it now.

output_contract.attention_score: Return probabilities over the supplied ordered levels, not a normalized score or action. Code will validate, calculate and normalize scores under a versioned policy.
output_contract.attention_reason_tags: Return scores only for the supplied attention-reason tags.
output_contract.emotion_tags: Return scores only for the supplied emotion tags.
output_contract.thought_tags: Return scores only for the supplied thought tags.
output_contract.choice: Return exactly one supplied choice and no explanation.

attention_criteria_draft: The person has no willingness to pay attention to this object now.
The person has a slight willingness to pay attention to this object now.
The person has a clear willingness to pay attention to this object now.
The person has a strong willingness to pay attention to this object now.

implementation.scope: Offline prototype; not a JEV/OpenRouter request adapter.
implementation.output_aliases: Neutral question/option aliases are mapped back to registry IDs or actions outside the model.
implementation.input_shape: The executable input uses stage, scope, encounter_no, persona, visible_tags, facts, history, relationship_state, stage-specific object memory and explicitly scoped state objects. Unknown top-level fields are rejected.
implementation.score_warning: The attention scale is a design proposal and has not been calibrated.
implementation.trust_boundary: Visibility and source references must be verified by a future trusted context loader; the renderer cannot prove source ownership.
